_note: Seeded 2026-09-14 from direct repository inspection during /jrs-init. Counts are FACT as at the commit recorded in PROGRAM_STATE.json. Rights and status fields are carried from the authoritative baseline in docs/enterprise-diligence/ and are NOT re-derived here.
basis: The contributor instrument covers study publications including successor transfer. It is silent on licensing, commercial products, revenue and vendor platforms.
prohibition: Silence is not permission. Rule 5 governs.
_extended_2026_09_18: Extended with the rights-to-product map. The seeded status, basis and prohibition above are UNCHANGED and still govern. This adds the per-right breakdown for the one product the architecture actually contemplates, so a future licence conversation starts from what is established rather than from what is hoped.

_classifications.RIGHT FACT ESTABLISHED: A fact in the record supports it. Not a legal conclusion.
_classifications.RIGHT LEGALLY INTERPRETED: A lawyer has construed the instruments. NONE ARE.
_classifications.RIGHT CONTRACTUALLY GRANTED: An executed instrument grants it. NONE EXIST - F-4.
_classifications.RIGHT AVAILABLE FOR LICENSING: Could be licensed today on the evidence held. Requires the two above.
_classifications.RIGHT REQUIRES COUNSEL CONFIRMATION: The facts are gathered; the construction is not ours to make.

_governing_facts: F-4: no executed signed instrument exists anywhere in the corpus. NO right below is CONTRACTUALLY GRANTED, and none can be until one exists.
33 executed structured contributor consents cover study publications including successor transfer, and are SILENT on licensing, commercial products, revenue and vendor platforms.
E-034 (owner attestation): Ubayet approved the uses discussed and stated no restriction on commercial or licensing use. ABSENCE OF A PROHIBITION IS NOT A GRANT.
E-029 (owner attestation): the owner conceived, directed, reviewed, selected and accepted the work. This is provenance, NOT an ownership determination.
No licensee, no licence draft, no payment gateway, $0 revenue.
product: JRS Review Engine Evaluation License (contemplated; NOT available for execution)

methodology.what: The five conditions, DRR, the Codebook
methodology.evidence: Publicly attributed to Wikes 2026-06-02 and 2026-07-02, externally timestamped (F-5, E-025 to E-027). E-029 supplies conception and direction.
methodology.classification: RIGHT FACT ESTABLISHED as to authorship and public attribution. REQUIRES COUNSEL CONFIRMATION as to whether that supports licensing.
methodology.gap: Authorship is not ownership. No instrument.

software.what: Review Engine, API, manifest library, guards
software.evidence: 100% of surviving lines in core implementation carry the AI tool identity (F-11); E-029 supplies human conception, direction, selection and acceptance.
software.gap: The authorship position for AI-assisted code is exactly the question E-029 informs and does not answer. Recorded in the register as an evidentiary limitation at artifact level, not as an absence of human involvement.

trademark.evidence: Use on 23 public pages. F-8: NO filing or registration evidence located.
trademark.classification: RIGHT FACT ESTABLISHED as to USE only.
trademark.gap: Unregistered. A licence granting trademark rights would grant something unregistered, which is a drafting matter and a valuation matter, not a blocker to the engine licence.

training.what: Six-module training, field guides, reference library
training.classification: RIGHT FACT ESTABLISHED as to authorship.
training.gap: Same instrument gap as methodology. Cleanest of the assets.

research_and_validation_evidence.what: The constructed corpus, panel results, manuscripts a licensee would rely on
research_and_validation_evidence.evidence: 33 consents scoped to study publications and successor transfer. FOUR co-author relationships, all outside the co-author instrument, which is recorded NOT USED, confirmed 0 of 3.
research_and_validation_evidence.classification: NOT ESTABLISHED for licensing. REQUIRES COUNSEL CONFIRMATION.
research_and_validation_evidence.gap: THE SHARPEST ONE COMMERCIALLY. The validation evidence a licensee would rely on is jointly held, the consents are silent on licensing, and reviewer consent is REVOCABLE AT WILL. A revocable permission cannot support an exclusive perpetual grant. This is a transaction condition, not a defect.

contributor_supplied_records.evidence: E-031: entered through the submission link by Young and Pokhriyal; the owner personally reviewed them for de-identification. Contributors were instructed to submit already-public, de-identified material (B-013B).
contributor_supplied_records.classification: RIGHT FACT ESTABLISHED as to provenance and review. REQUIRES COUNSEL CONFIRMATION as to commercial reuse.
contributor_supplied_records.gap: The instruction scoped submissions to public material, which limits the exposure. It does not by itself establish a right to license the corpus.

section_2_1_reference.what: The accessibility argument referenced at Section 2.1
section_2_1_reference.evidence: E-033: an approach from Gabriela Cortez's MCCR intake work. NOT a formal contribution to the study.
section_2_1_reference.classification: NOT A STUDY ASSET. Removed from the contribution inventory.
section_2_1_reference.gap: X-15: whether referencing an approach originating in state-agency employment carries any third-party interest. NEW, counsel-adjacent, unanswered.

derivatives_and_improvements.gap: A licence must allocate these expressly. Nothing currently does.

third_party.evidence: No provider terms captured in the repository. No npm tree (F-12).
third_party.classification: NOT ESTABLISHED as to flow-down obligations.
third_party.gap: A licensee will ask what terms bind them downstream. Nothing answers that today.

territory_field_version.what: Territory, field of use, version scope
territory_field_version.evidence: Nothing addresses any of the three.
territory_field_version.gap: Drafting dimensions, not evidence gaps. Listed so a licence does not omit them.

determination.available_for_licensing_today: NOTHING. Not one right reaches RIGHT AVAILABLE FOR LICENSING, because none is CONTRACTUALLY GRANTED and none is LEGALLY INTERPRETED. That is a statement about instruments and construction, NOT about the quality of the asset.
determination.what_this_map_is_for: So that a licence conversation begins from the established position rather than from an assumption, and so the two conditions that would actually bite - jointly held validation evidence and revocable consent - are on the table before terms are drafted rather than after.
determination.counsel_dependency: B-004, and X-15 joins its channel.
